description: ButlerBrain gives your AI a persistent memory. Save thoughts, search notes, crawl web pages, manage calendar events, and upload documents, all accessible across any AI assistant. Your brain integrates natively with several tools including Obsidian, and every memory is semantically searchable.

defaultPrompt: What do I know about Lily?
Remember that Lily's soccer moved to Thursdays at 4pm at Liberty Park.
Tell me everything you know about Lily across all my memories.
